Definition: a Berothite, or inhabitant of Berothai
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture Berothite means an inhabitant of Berothai, and it shows up only once, in 1 Chronicles 11:39.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Berothite still matters, even appearing only a few times, because God chose it.
